excerpts: Park at the city of Las Vegas parking garage, 500 S. Main St., and take the shuttle to and from First Friday. The shuttle runs from 3 p.m. to midnight.

Wherever you park, please make sure the spot is clearly signed for public or event parking; never park anywhere that is not. Never park in a dirt lot - even if there are attendants; these are not legitimate parking locations and you risk being towed.
